verdict.rationale: Vue's official docs list a first-party 'Tutorial' section in the main navigation, so the project ships its own tutorial. Nothing in the evidence shows it is interactive or runs in the browser without local setup. The CDN script-tag quick start is a separate buildless setup option, not an in-browser tutorial, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: evidence the tutorial is interactive and in-browser (e.g., an embedded editor or live preview), evidence it needs no local setup, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can try an in-browser interactive tutorial to learn the framework hands-on without any local setup
